scope: Open baseline paper from the MultiTex trial defining byssinosis assessment in cotton textile workers, including Schilling criteria.

keyRecommendations.text: The paper studies byssinosis and lung health in cotton textile workers.
Schilling’s criteria are symptoms with a decreased FEV1.
An FEV1/FVC below the lower limit of normal after bronchodilator was treated as chronic airflow obstruction in the study.

clinicalBottomLine: Byssinosis in this source is an occupational cotton-dust disease assessed with symptom criteria, including Schilling’s criteria of symptoms plus a fall in FEV1, not a community COPD label.
notableCaveats: This is a single-city baseline cohort, not a treatment guideline. Do not generalise its prevalence as the natural history of byssinosis.

source.title: Byssinosis and lung health among cotton textile workers: baseline findings of the MultiTex trial in Karachi, Pakistan.
